# help remove
remove* - Remove entities such as virtual volumes and logical disks.
In each case type "help <command>" for detailed help.

    removealert        - remove one or more alerts
    removebanner       - remove banners
    removecert         - remove a SSL service's certificate
    removecpg          - remove Common Provisioning Groups (CPGs)
                         or LDs from CPGs.
    removedomain       - remove domains
    removedomainset    - remove a domain set or domains from a set
    removefileshare    - remove a fileshare from a filesystem
    removefilesystem   - remove a filesystem from the system
    removehost         - remove a host or path(s) to a host.
    removehostset      - remove a host set or hosts from a set.
    removekeys         - remove keys for a service.
    removeld           - remove logical disks
    removercopygroup   - remove  groups used for Remote Copy
    removercopytarget  - remove a target used for Remote Copy
    removesched        - remove a scheduled task
    removesharesetting - remove a share setting
    removesnmpmgr      - remove an SNMP trap manager
    removesnmppw       - remove an SNMP password
    removesnmpuser     - remove an SNMP user
    removespare        - remove spare chunklets
    removesralertcrit  - remove System Reporter threshold alert criterion
    removesshkey       - remove SSH public keys
    removetask         - remove tasks or task details
    removeuser         - remove user accounts
    removeuserconn     - remove user connection
    removevlun         - remove virtual LUNs
    removevv           - remove volumes (including snapshot volumes)
    removevvolsc       - remove a vVol Storage Container and all of its Protocol
                         Endpoints
    removevvset        - remove a VV set or VVs from a set
    removewsapisession - remove WSAPI user sessions
